title: Literature in English — Form 2
description: A second-year literature course with original stories, poems and scenes: plot and conflict, character development, sound devices in poetry, mood and tone, conflict in drama, riddles, songs and oral performance, irony, hyperbole and symbol, and the point-evidence-explain paragraph. Official set texts are not included.
